core_obligations: Prove the vanishing statement (proof lines 2650-2671): restrict the dualizing module of the blowup to the exceptional divisor and identify it with the dualizing module of the divisor twisted by the negative of the twist; the resulting short exact sequences with the direct image of the twisted dualizing module of the exceptional divisor, together with the vanishing of the first cohomology of the latter on the curve, show that the maps between the first cohomology groups of the twists of the dualizing module are surjective; since these groups vanish for large twist, descending induction gives the vanishing for all nonnegative twists.

Conclude global generation and surjectivity (proof lines 2673-2685): the restriction of the dualizing module to the exceptional divisor is the dualizing module of the curve twisted by the twist, hence globally generated; the vanishing just proved makes the restriction map on global sections surjective, so the dualizing module itself is globally generated; the surjectivity of the map from the pullback of the dualizing module of the base follows because the global sections of the dualizing module are the dualizing module of the base, which is what defines that map.
proof_roadmap: Identify the restriction of the dualizing module of the blowup to the exceptional divisor.
Run the descending chain of cohomology groups to get vanishing for nonnegative twists.
Use global generation on the curve to make the dualizing module globally generated and deduce surjectivity.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves, in the rational situation with a non-regular base admitting a dualizing complex, that the dualizing module of the blowup restricts to the dualizing module of the exceptional divisor twisted by the negative of the twist, that the first cohomology of all nonnegative twists vanishes, and that the map from the pullback of the dualizing module of the base to the dualizing module of the blowup is surjective (statement lines 2640-2649). The proof (proof lines 2650-2685) identifies the restriction to the exceptional divisor, runs a descending induction on the cohomology groups, and concludes global generation and surjectivity. H3: several computed steps with a descending induction, written out in full.
